sqlquery.from: (select distinct tk.name as taskname,tk.id, mu.id as assigneeid, (mu.firstName||' '||mu.lastname) as assignee, tk.description, tk.startdate, tk.duedate, tk.creationtime, tk.estimatedtime, tk.percent, tk.billable, st.name as taskstatus, ts.totaltime, pj.name as projectname, wst.name as workstreamname, cl.name as clientname, ma.id as managerid, (ma.firstname ||' '|| ma.lastname) as manager, bma.id as backmanagerid, (bma.firstname ||' '|| bma.lastname) as backmanager, tm.leaderid from "$".task tk LEFT JOIN "reference" st on st.id= tk.statusid LEFT JOIN "$".employeetask emtk on emtk.taskid = tk.id LEFT JOIN "$".projectemployee pjem on emtk.projectemployeeid = pjem.id LEFT JOIN "$".project pj on pjem.projectid = pj.id LEFT JOIN "$".teamemployee tmem on pjem.employeedepartmentid = tmem.id LEFT JOIN "$".myuser mu on tmem.employeeid = mu.id LEFT JOIN "$".team tm on tm.id = tmem.teamid LEFT JOIN "$".myuser ma ON ma.id = pj.managerid LEFT JOIN "$".myuser bma on bma.id = pj.backup_managerid LEFT JOIN "$".workstream wst ON wst.id = tk.parentwsid LEFT JOIN "$".crmaccount cl ON pj.clientid = cl.id LEFT JOIN (select "$".timesheet.taskid,sum("$".timesheet.timespent) as totaltime from "$".timesheet group by "$".timesheet.employeetaskid,timesheet.taskid) ts ON ts.taskid = emtk.taskid WHERE pj.isdeleted!=true AND tk.deleted!=true AND (tk.isissue is null OR tk.isissue!=true)) t
